title: Technical analysis contract ta-3.4
description: The stable summary of one stock's swing and position runs that other tools read, built by scripts/contract.py. Within a major version fields are only ever added; renaming or removing one means a new major version. 1.1 adds event.last_earnings, event.days_since_last_earnings, event.last_earnings_move and the kind of each scenario target. 1.2 adds levels_note, range_95 and the volatility-band stop and target with calibrated touch rates in stops_ref; the support/resistance zones are reference only. 2.0 removes event.eps_estimated: the contract carries no fundamentals. 2.1 adds data_quality.calendar_source, the dividend and macro blocks, trend.sma100 (a context line, not part of the SMA stack) and, per horizon, ex_dividend_within_horizon, macro_within_horizon and macro_complete; trading-day counts (event.trading_days_to, data_quality.business_days_behind) now count NYSE sessions, exchange holidays excluded. 3.0 removes every score: the per-horizon bias (weighted score, label, confidence), pillars and weights_used, the pillar of each signal or pattern and context_only.scored; the contract carries no scores, ratings or bias. 3.1 adds volatility.squeeze_last_release, the last bar the squeeze switched off (its date, bars ago, direction and how many bars the squeeze had lasted). 3.2 adds, per horizon, current_zone (the zone the last close is in, which is on neither side), each zone's last_break and holds_since_break, and the price_location state inside_zone; zones may be up to 1.5 ATR wide and a break now cancels one hold in the score. 3.3 adds trend.structure and weekly.structure (the swing structure of the daily and the weekly chart: whether the last swing highs and lows are higher or lower, and the price that ends the sequence), per horizon trendlines (the up line along the swing lows and the down line along the swing highs of the levels window), and at_level / level on candlestick patterns (the key zone the pattern formed at); zone sources may now name weekly_pivot_high / weekly_pivot_low (swings of the weekly chart, candidates for both horizons) and round_number, a side short of three zones may list round-number zones (marked round_fill), and conflicts may list trend_vs_structure. 3.4 changes how price-action setups are measured and adds what a chart reader asks of them: every setup is entered on a stop beyond its signal bar on the next bar (a price-action pattern's fired_date is its signal bar; its statistics and baselines run from that entry; a setup whose next bar did not trigger is not in patterns but in context_only.lapsed_setups), each price-action pattern carries entry, signal_bar, variant, at_level / level, range_third and line, the library adds range H2 / L2, double tops and bottoms, major trend reversals and breakouts with follow-through (wedges now use the ATR ZigZag swings of the key levels), context_only adds pa_state_pending (the state now needs three bars in a row to change), climax, breakout_mode, last_breakout, last_wedge, last_double and last_mtr, and each trendline carries its channel_line. Ex-dividend dates and macro events are context. Horizon-independent blocks sit at the top, the rest under horizons.swing / horizons.position. Prices are split-adjusted closes; fractions are decimals (0.05 = 5%); null means missing, never estimated.

business_days_behind.description: NYSE sessions after the last bar up to the session that should be complete at the run's time (exchange holidays excluded; the name is kept from 2.0)

partial_bar_excluded.description: date of today's bar when it was dropped

calendar_source.description: the exchange calendar behind every session count: FMP's NYSE holiday list united with the exchange rules, or the rules alone when FMP's list could not be loaded

reason.description: why not, e.g. an ETF or a restricted plan

trading_days_to.description: NYSE sessions from as_of to the report date (exchange holidays excluded; FMP gives no before-open / after-close time)

last_earnings.description: latest report on or before as_of (YYYY-MM-DD)

days_since_last_earnings.description: calendar days from last_earnings to as_of

last_earnings_move.description: two-day move around the latest report; null while the bar after it is missing

median_abs_move.description: median absolute two-day move around past reports

dividend.description: ex-dividend dates from FMP dividends (amounts split-adjusted, the basis of the prices). On the ex-date the price opens lower by about the dividend for mechanical reasons. Context only; no dividend yield. Whether the next ex-date falls inside a horizon is under horizons.*

reason.description: why not, e.g. a restricted plan

pays_dividends.description: false for a symbol FMP lists no dividends for, or whose dividends look suspended

next_ex_date.description: first announced ex-dividend date after as_of; null when none is announced yet

next_trading_days_to.description: NYSE sessions from as_of to the ex-date

last_ex_date.description: latest ex-dividend date on or before as_of

macro.description: scheduled US macro releases after as_of from FMP's economic calendar, tiers 1-2 (metrics.json also lists tier 3). Dates and times only, never an expected outcome; context only. Which fall inside a horizon is under horizons.*

reason.description: why not: a restricted plan, a failed request, or an answer without US rows (missing data, not a window without events)

window_to.description: last date requested; FMP returns at most ~90 days per request

listed_through.description: FMP lists releases other than FOMC dates only some weeks ahead: the date of the last one listed; events after it may be missing

events.description: in session order; null when unavailable

squeeze_last_release.description: 3.1: the last bar the squeeze switched off, of any length (the squeeze_release_up / _down signals need 5 bars or more); null when it never did in the history

direction.description: the close vs the 20-day SMA on that bar

squeeze_bars_before.description: how many bars the squeeze had lasted when it switched off

extension.description: how stretched the price is (overbought / oversold inputs)

structure.description: 3.3: swing structure of the daily chart (ATR ZigZag swings of 1.5 daily ATR, the same swings as the key levels); a reading next to the averages, not a regime vote; null when the last 504 bars hold fewer than two swing highs and two swing lows

sma100.description: 100-day SMA, a widely watched reference line (2.1): context only, not part of stack / stack_state and never a trend vote; null with fewer than 100 bars

slopes.description: 20-bar slope of each SMA, keyed sma20 / sma50 / sma100 / sma200

close_vs.description: close / SMA - 1, keyed sma20 / sma50 / sma100 / sma200

stack.description: SMA20 / SMA50 / SMA200 ordered top to bottom, e.g. 20>50>200 (SMA100 is not part of it)

state.description: a trend with a direction is uptrend / downtrend; a trend without one is transitional

structure.description: 3.3: swing structure of the weekly chart (ZigZag swings of 1.5 weekly ATR over complete weeks: the major swings); invalidation.distance_atr is in daily ATRs

context_only.description: price-action state and recent candlesticks: context

pa_state.description: tight_bull_channel, bull_channel, trading_range, bear_channel or tight_bear_channel. 3.4: the state changes only after the bars have read differently three bars in a row (or at once on a breakout with follow-through), and while the close is on a channel's side of the EMA the channel is kept on lower thresholds than it is entered on

pa_state_pending.description: 3.4: the latest reading (label) when it differs from pa_state, and for how many bars in a row the reading has differed (the state changes at three); null when they agree

climax.description: 3.4: three or more trend bars in a row in one direction, the last closing more than 2 ATR beyond the 20 EMA. active: on the last bar; last: the most recent one

breakout_mode.description: 3.4: the last ii (two inside bars) or ioi (inside, outside, inside) with its date, the high and low of its last bar, and broke: up, down, both or null (not yet)

last_breakout.description: 3.4: the last trend bar that closed beyond a trading range: side, date, level (the range edge), follow_through (the next bar closed further the same way; null when that bar is not in yet) and holding (no close back inside since)

last_wedge.description: 3.4: the last three-push wedge: side (top / bottom), the date its third push was confirmed, bars_ago

last_double.description: 3.4: the last double top / bottom: side, variant (reversal: at the 60-bar extreme; flag: a lower double top or higher double bottom), confirmed_date, bars_ago

last_mtr.description: 3.4: the last major trend reversal setup: side (top / bottom), variant (higher_low, lower_high or double), signal_date, bars_ago

lapsed_setups.description: 3.4: price-action setups of the last 3 bars whose next bar did not trade beyond the signal bar: no entry, so they are not in patterns (id, bias, fired_date, bars_ago, trigger_price)

skipped.description: data the run did not fetch (e.g. earnings and sector for SPY)

modules_unavailable.description: module (or module.part) -> reason, from both runs

last_break.description: 3.2: date of the most recent break of the zone; null if it never broke in the window

holds_since_break.description: 3.2: holds after last_break (every hold if it never broke): the zone's record in its present role

sources.description: the candidates inside the zone; 3.3 adds weekly_pivot_high / weekly_pivot_low (swings of the weekly chart) and round_number

round_fill.description: 3.3: true for a round-number zone that has not earned its place on the test record and is listed only because its side has fewer than three zones; treat it as a weak reference

close_position.description: current_zone only: where the last close sits in the zone, 0 at its bottom and 1 at its top

kind.description: level = a support/resistance zone; projection = no level beyond the trigger, so trigger +- k ATR

structural.description: far edge of the zone the close is in, else of the nearest level, - 0.5 ATR; reference only

vol.description: last close x (1 -+ 2.4 x rv20 x sqrt(h / 252)): the calibrated 95% band edge

vol_target.description: last close x (1 +- rv20 x sqrt(h / 252)): the 1-sigma band edge

touch_rate.description: share of calibration paths that reached a price this far from the close within the horizon

primary.description: the stop the risk module sizes its example on

id.description: group id, e.g. fomc, cpi, jobs, pce, ppi, gdp, retail_sales (tier 1), fomc_minutes, fed_policy, ism_manufacturing, ism_services, jolts, consumer_sentiment (tier 2)

time_ny.description: HH:MM New York time of the earliest release of the group that day; null when FMP gives a date only

session.description: the first NYSE session the release can move: that day, or the next session after the close, a weekend or a holiday

time_ny.description: HH:MM New York time; null when FMP gives a date only

timing.description: after_close and non_session first reach prices in the next NYSE session

trading_days_to.description: NYSE sessions in (as_of, the session the release can first move]

edge_median.description: median return minus the same-regime baseline

confirmed.description: sample-backed edge over the same-regime baseline in the signal's direction

at_level.description: 3.3 candlestick patterns, 3.4 also price-action setups: the pattern formed at a key zone of this horizon, a bullish one at a support zone or the zone the close is in, a bearish one at a resistance zone or the zone the close is in (a price-action setup is placed by the price it hangs on: its pullback low, third push, second bottom, the test's extreme); null when the key levels are unavailable. A label: the statistics are those of the pattern wherever it formed

entry.description: 3.4, price-action setups only: the stop entry. fired_date is the signal bar; the setup is entered when the next bar trades beyond trigger_price (the signal bar's high for a bullish setup, its low for a bearish one), at that price or at the open if the bar opens beyond it. The statistics of the row run from that entry price

status.description: pending: the signal bar is the last bar, so the order is still open; triggered: the next bar took it

signal_bar.description: 3.4, price-action setups only. strong: a bar in the setup's direction (not a doji) closing in the outer third of its range and no taller than 2 ATR

variant.description: 3.4, price-action setups only: reversal / flag for a double top or bottom, higher_low / lower_high / double for a major trend reversal, else null

range_third.description: 3.4, price-action setups only: where the setup's reference price sits in the trading range, when one is on

line.description: 3.4, price-action setups only: the trendline or channel line (of this horizon's trendlines) the setup's reference price sits on, within 0.25 ATR

price.description: the line's price at the setup's reference bar

level.description: 3.3 (3.4: price-action setups too): the zone the pattern formed at, null when at_level is not true

label.description: S1..S3, R1..R3 (index into supports / resistances, from 1) or Z (current_zone)

provisional.description: true for the swing in progress: it has closed beyond the last confirmed swing of its side but no reversal has confirmed it yet, so its price can still extend

structure.description: Dow-theory reading of the last swings. A swing is an ATR ZigZag pivot (confirmed once price reverses 1.5 ATR from it); the swing in progress counts once a close passes the last swing of its side

state.description: uptrend = the last swing high and the last swing low are both higher than the ones before; downtrend = both lower; mixed = anything else

highs.description: last swing high against the one before; equal = within 0.25 ATR

invalidation.description: the price that ends the sequence: a close below the last swing low of an uptrend, or above the last swing high of a downtrend; null when mixed

trendline.description: a straight line (arithmetic price scale, one step per trading day) through two swings of the levels window; null when the swings make no line whose two points are at least 20 bars apart and which moves at least 0.01 ATR a bar

slope_per_bar.description: price change of the line per trading day

price.description: the line's price at the last bar

touches.description: swings within 0.25 ATR of the line, its two points included

state.description: broken = a close after the second point lay more than 0.25 ATR beyond the line

broken_on.description: the first such close; null while intact

close_side.description: where the last close is against the line now

channel_line.description: 3.4: the parallel to the trendline through the swing on the other side that lies farthest from it between the line's two points (a swing high for an up trendline); null when there is none

price.description: the channel line's price at the last bar

position.description: where the last close sits between the two lines: 0 on the trendline, 1 on the channel line

overshoots.description: bars after the trendline's second point whose high (low for a down channel) went more than 0.25 ATR beyond the channel line

horizon_days.description: primary statistics horizon in trading days

conflicts.description: where the readings disagree, each with its typical meaning; listed only

state.description: inside_zone (3.2) = the close is in current_zone; inside_support / inside_resistance = the close is at the edge of that zone (within 0.1 ATR of it)

zone.description: index into supports / resistances; null for inside_zone

current_zone.description: 3.2: the zone the last close is in (at least 0.1 ATR inside both edges), with close_position; null when the close is in no zone. It is neither a support nor a resistance: the bull trigger is its top and the bear trigger its bottom

supports.description: zones below the close, nearest first

resistances.description: zones above the close, nearest first

trendlines.description: 3.3: sloping support and resistance of the levels window, reported next to the zones and never mixed into them; reference only, like the zones. null when the key levels are unavailable

up.description: along the swing lows: from the window's lowest swing low through the later swing low that keeps every later swing low on or above the line

down.description: the mirror along the swing highs

range_95.description: last close x (1 +- k x rv20 x sqrt(h / 252)); k calibrated so the band held about 95% of h-day closes (2 sigma held only 92-93%)

low.description: null when the band reaches zero

coverage.description: share of h-day closes inside in calibration

stops_ref.description: reference stops from the risk module; position sizing is the caller's job

ex_dividend_within_horizon.description: the next ex-dividend date is at most horizon_days NYSE sessions away; null when unknown (none announced, or no dividend data); false for a symbol that pays none

macro_within_horizon.description: tier 1-2 macro events at most horizon_days NYSE sessions away, each with its date, New York time and timing; null when the economic calendar is unavailable (restricted, failed or without US rows)

macro_complete.description: whether FMP's listing reaches the horizon's end (macro.listed_through and the request window); false: events late in the horizon may be missing; null when the economic calendar is unavailable

patterns.description: price-action setups and candlestick patterns with their statistics
